# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D]=demonstrated, [A]=anticipated, [T]=target.

- [T] "the number of people that turned up" and whether "we grown the community particularly to new sectors like artists environmentalists."
- [T] Have we "succeeded in visualizing what we're talking about to people who just don't like the words but they can just experience it visually and use the interface."
- [T] "is the interface to the earth operating system an actual interface that people respect and say wow that's a good interface."
- [A] "it will be forked and spun" — "the externalities start happening more and more."
- [T] "stars on git" — the "hitchhiker um ide is like in the top hundred gits."
- [D] Max's working Oasis IDE "cursor clone" vibe-coding "using holons."
- [T] Brand test: "is it funny is it... punk... accessible," "does it have its own x account."

**Headline metric.** "do we get an endorsement from tom by from by tom from myspace... that's the the gold standard metric."
